text:
maya_cs: FYI we got an escalation from ACME — their latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after the 11:22 deploy. Customer seeing only p50 and mean. they're worried about SLOs.

sam_choi: ugh, saw a spike in support tickets too. do we have a deploy ID?

maya_cs: deploy-bot posted: `deploy: services/metrics-api @ 2024-04-05T11:22:43Z (id: d-20240405-112243)` — customer reported right after that.

deploy-bot: Deployment d-20240405-112243 to prod completed in 28s. changed: metrics-api v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0.

anika_obs: I'll take a look at the dashboard config. initial guess: percentile aggregation key changed or metrics name rename. Can someone drop the raw Prometheus query?

leo_platform: Dashboard uses our central PromQL: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,route) (rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])))` and similar for 0.99.

sam_choi: ran a quick check — querying raw series for `request_latency_bucket` shows COUNT reduced to 0 for many routes: `count_over_time(request_latency_bucket[5m])` returns 0 for several route label values since ~11:22.

anika_obs: hmm. run `curl -sS https://metrics-api.internal/metrics?metric=request_latency_bucket&route=/generate | head` to see if ingestion changed. also check the instrumenting lib version bumped in v2.4.0.

sam_choi: pasted output: 
```
# HELP request_latency_bucket Request latency histogram buckets
# TYPE request_latency_bucket histogram
request_latency_bucket{route="/generate",le="0.1"} 0
request_latency_bucket{route="/generate",le="0.5"} 0
request_latency_bucket{route="/generate",le="1.0"} 0
```
Looks like the service is emitting 0s now. before deploy it had values.

anika_obs: OK that suggests instrumentation or metrics flush behavior changed. check service logs for metrics flush errors: `grep -i "metrics" /var/log/metrics-api/*.log | tail -n 200`

leo_platform: log snippet: `ERROR metrics: failed to serialize histogram: json: unsupported value: +Inf` repeated many times at 11:22:45.

sam_choi: ah — new prometheus client lib (v1.11) changed how +Inf bucket is represented, our serializer choked and dropped series. that would make percentile queries return empty.

maya_cs: customer impacted -> they want ETA. can we hotfix?

anika_obs: mitigation options: 1) rollback metrics-api to v2.3.1 (fastest), 2) patch serializer to handle +Inf and rollout (a bit slower), 3) tweak dashboard to fallback to precomputed quantiles (careful). I recommend rollback for customer-facing SLO visibility.

leo_platform: prepared rollback runbook: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/metrics-api metrics-api=metrics-api:2.3.1 && rollout status deploy/metrics-api` — should be <5m.

sam_choi: I'll coordinate rollback now, ping once done. @anika_obs can you prepare an incident ticket with repro and root cause? include logs and promql dumps.

anika_obs: creating incident INC-20240405-37 with summary: "metrics-api serialization error after prometheus client bump — p95/p99 missing". adding links to deploy d-20240405-112243, logs, and query examples.

metrics-bot: Incident INC-20240405-37 created and routed to eng-sre, severity: high.

sam_choi: rollback started. `kubectl rollout undo deploy/metrics-api --to-revision=20240405-112000` -> rollback in progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback action requested for d-20240405-112243 by sam_choi.

sam_choi: rollout completed, metrics returning. re-checking histogram: `count_over_time(request_latency_bucket[5m])` now shows non-zero. dashboard p95/p99 lines reappeared after Grafana datasource refresh.

maya_cs: customer notified, they confirmed the p95 line is back. thanks team. :tada:

anika_obs: follow-ups: - revert dependency bump in metrics-api until serializer fixed - add e2e test that validates histogram buckets are exported (covers +Inf) - add dashboard alert if percentile queries return empty for >2min.

leo_platform: opening PR to add test + alert. tagging sam_choi for review.

sam_choi: thumbs up. postmortem in #postmortems, link INC-20240405-37 once ready.

maya_cs: closing loop with customer now. great response time.

metrics-bot: Alert: p50/p90 metrics stable, p95/p99 missing threshold cleared.
